title: 望天门山
author: Li Bai

translation: tianmen mountain splits apart to let the chu river through
blue water flows east and swerves back at this point
green peaks on either bank rise up to face each other
a single sail comes from the direction of the sun

appreciation: The mountain seems to crack open so the river can rush through, and the current whirls back as if stunned. Green cliffs advance toward the boat while a lone sail appears out of the sunrise. The poem matters because Li Bai writes landscape as motion and force, making the traveler feel small and exhilarated at the same time.
